## Change

Describe the resulting behavior and affected content/routes.

## Content verification

For changed business facts/media, record the approved source and approver (or state why this is not a factual content change). Do not put secrets or private documents in this PR.

- [ ] No invented dates, contacts, address, inventory, pricing or affiliation claims
- [ ] Relevant metadata and cautious wording reviewed
- [ ] Affected preview/screenshots, responsive behavior and accessibility reviewed
- [ ] Quality checks and production CI pass

## Validation

Commands/results and any genuine remaining owner inputs.
